verdict.rationale: Workers documents 'built-in observability', and Cloudflare exposes separate managed MCP servers for Workers Builds and Observability. That points to build and runtime visibility, but nothing shows build, deploy, and runtime logs unified in one view. missing for 10: evidence of a single unified log view spanning build, deploy, and runtime; explicit runtime log viewing/tailing docs; deploy log visibility; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view all my build, deploy, and runtime logs in one place

citations.quote: Gain deep visibility and insight with built-in observability
